description: Uroc1 knockout mouse phenotype breadth and cross-species orthologs
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}

r=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/mi/impc/solr/statistical-result/select",
   params={"q":"marker_symbol:Uroc1","wt":"json","rows":2000,
           "fl":"procedure_name,parameter_name,zygosity,p_value,significant,mp_term_name"},
   headers=H,timeout=90).json()["response"]["docs"]
sr=pd.DataFrame(r)
sr["significant"]=sr["significant"].astype(bool)
summ=sr.groupby("procedure_name").agg(tests=("parameter_name","size"), sig=("significant","sum")).sort_values("tests",ascending=False)
print(summ.to_string())
print("\nSignificant hits:")
print(sr[sr.significant][["procedure_name","parameter_name","mp_term_name","p_value"]].to_string(index=False))

# behavioural / neurological procedures specifically
neuro=["Open Field","Combined SHIRPA and Dysmorphology","Grip Strength",
       "Acoustic Startle and Pre-pulse Inhibition (PPI)","Light-Dark Test"]
nb=sr[sr.procedure_name.isin(neuro)]
print("\nNeurobehavioural parameters tested: %d, significant: %d"%(len(nb), nb.significant.sum()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,6))
s=summ.iloc[::-1]
ax.barh(s.index, s.tests, color="#5b6b7c", label="parameters tested, not significant")
ax.barh(s.index, s.sig, color="#b4553a", label="significant")
ax.set_xlabel("IMPC parameters")
ax.set_title("Uroc1 em1(IMPC)Bay homozygous knockout mice: 2 of 330 tests significant\nno ataxia, no neurodevelopmental or dysmorphology phenotype")
ax.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# Orthologs
a=requests.get("https://www.alliancegenome.org/api/gene/HGNC:26444/orthologs",headers=H,timeout=60).json()
print("\nOrthologs of human UROC1:")
for o in a.get("results",[]):
    g=o.get("homologGene") or o.get("gene")
    if g: print("   %-26s %-10s %s  best=%s"%(g["taxon"]["name"], g["symbol"], g["id"], o.get("best")))
